component.name: KDE ASCII Saver
component.summary: Animated ASCII idle screen for KDE Plasma 6

description.p: KDE ASCII Saver displays custom artwork with randomized terminal text animations when a Plasma session becomes idle. It supports multiple monitors, Wayland and X11, and hands control to KScreenLocker whenever the session locks.
The control panel manages automatic activation, idle delay, typography, colors, frame rate, artwork, previews, and installation diagnostics.
